name: Attested By
description: Signed entity's Sigstore signature was recorded in Rekor at this log entry, verified under the policy captured in the edge attributes at the captured time. Verdict + applied policy live on this edge (not on the rekor_log_entry node) because verification is a fact about (artifact bytes + bundle + policy + verification time), not an immutable property of the log entry.

signature_verified.description: Absolute verdict from verify_bundle. True if all of signature, cert chain, Rekor inclusion proof, and the supplied policy match.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC of the verification call that produced this verdict.

policy_kind.description: Kind of policy applied. v0 emits only 'github_workflow'.

policy_oidc_issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL the policy required.

policy_github_repository.description: GitHub repo the policy required (when policy_kind = github_workflow).

policy_workflow_identity_uri.description: Exact SAN URI the policy required, when supplied.

policy_workflow_ref.description: Git ref the policy required, when supplied.

policy_workflow_sha.description: Commit SHA the policy required, when supplied.

verification_failure_code.description: Machine-readable failure tag when signature_verified is false: bundle_parse, no_rekor_proof, policy_mismatch, cert_chain, rekor_proof, signature, unexpected. Empty when verified.

verification_failure_detail.description: Human-readable failure detail from the verifier when signature_verified is false. Empty when verified.
